name: Zvook acoustic station (Ukraine)
description: Half-metre acoustic mirror over one microphone with edge ML. Tower-mounted at 10-12 m, about 200 deg coverage, 5 km on Shahed-type OWA and 7 km on cruise missiles. Passive: it cannot be jammed or homed on.

detectRangeM.condition: up to 5000 m on a drone; 7000 m on a cruise missile
detectRangeM.source: Militarnyi, NATO Shows Interest in Ukrainian Acoustic Detection Networks for Air Defense, citing The Times

classifyRangeM.condition: classification range — No separate classification range is published. Zvook runs a multiclass model that recognises Shaheds, cruise missiles, turboprop and propeller aircraft, jet engines and helicopters; the detection event IS the class decision, so classification is modeled as available wherever detection is.
classifyRangeM.source: Ukraine develops acoustic system for determining azimuth of air targets / Militarnyi

sectorDeg.source: Militarnyi, NATO Shows Interest in Ukrainian Acoustic Detection Networks for Air Defense
